import pytest
from target import url_basename

@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "url,expected",
    [
        # Empty input
        ("", ""),
        # No path after domain (should not match)
        ("http://example.com", ""),
        ("https://example.com", ""),
        ("//example.com", ""),
        # Single path segment
        ("http://example.com/foo", "foo"),
        ("https://example.com/foo", "foo"),
        ("//example.com/foo", "foo"),
        # Single path segment with trailing slash
        ("http://example.com/foo/", "foo"),
        ("https://example.com/foo/", "foo"),
        ("//example.com/foo/", "foo"),
        # Single path segment with query
        ("http://example.com/foo?bar=1", "foo"),
        ("https://example.com/foo?bar=1", "foo"),
        ("//example.com/foo?bar=1", "foo"),
        # Single path segment with fragment
        ("http://example.com/foo#section", "foo"),
        ("https://example.com/foo#section", "foo"),
        ("//example.com/foo#section", "foo"),
        # Multiple path segments – should return the last segment
        ("http://example.com/a/b/c", "c"),
        ("https://example.com/a/b/c", "c"),
        ("//example.com/a/b/c", "c"),
        # Multiple path segments with trailing slash – last non‑empty segment
        ("http://example.com/a/b/c/", "c"),
        ("https://example.com/a/b/c/", "c"),
        ("//example.com/a/b/c/", "c"),
        # Multiple path segments with query after last segment
        ("http://example.com/a/b/c?x=1", "c"),
        ("https://example.com/a/b/c?x=1", "c"),
        ("//example.com/a/b/c?x=1", "c"),
        # Multiple path segments with fragment after last segment
        ("http://example.com/a/b/c#frag", "c"),
        ("https://example.com/a/b/c#frag", "c"),
        ("//example.com/a/b/c#frag", "c"),
        # Path segment containing characters that were previously allowed in the optional part
        ("http://example.com/a/b?c/d", "b"),
        ("http://example.com/a/b#c/d", "b"),
    ],
)
def test_url_basename_behaviour(url, expected):
    assert url_basename(url) == expected
